description: Three bounded discovery actions used Russian, Belarusian, and English wording. Results were noisy and mostly surfaced historical protest coverage, unrelated current-year pages, or off-scope material; no body was opened and no 2026 Belarus gathering was verified. Search failure to surface an event is not evidence none occurred.
